paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Yirmeyah, Sotah 4a. Kahana bar Yirmeyah, Orlah ch. 3, halakhah 2.
Rabbi Meyisha son of Rabbi Yirmeyah, Yerushalmi, end of Nazir. Menashya bar Yirmeyah, Pesachim 68a.
Rav Sama son of Rav Yirmeyah, Ketubot 33a. Rava bar Yirmeyah, Berakhot 43a. Rabbah bar Yirmeyah, Pesachim 36a.

notes.text: The notice leaves the source of the Orlah chapter/halakhah reference unspecified; it is not automatically labeled Jerusalem Talmud or Tosefta. Rava and Rabbah remain separate spellings.
